literal: In the mind blemish without-he being, all that virtue; empty-show nature-of others.
translation: Being spotless in one's mind is the entirety of virtue. All else is merely the nature of empty show.
modern: ஒருவன் தன் மனத்தில் குற்றம் இல்லாதவனாக இருப்பதே முழுமையான அறமாகும். மற்றவை எல்லாம் வெறும் ஆரவாரத் தன்மை கொண்டவை.
explanation: This couplet defines the core of virtue as inner purity. The phrase 'மனத்துக்கண் மாசிலன் ஆதல்' emphasizes that true righteousness is simply the state of being free from mental blemishes. The word 'அனைத்து' asserts that this inner purity constitutes the entirety of virtue. Everything else ('பிற'), such as outward displays of goodness, is dismissed as 'ஆகுல நீர', meaning they are of the nature of noisy, empty show.
